skill.name: bole-qwen38-persistent-service-handoff-v3
skill.title: Verify that a required service outlives the tool session
skill.description: Tasks that explicitly require starting a server or leaving a service reachable for later clients after the agent finishes.
skill.whenToUse: Use only when the task explicitly requires starting a server, hosting a local index, or leaving an API service running for later clients.
skill.body: For a service needed after the agent finishes, a tool background-job ID, plain `command &`, and PPID 1 alone do not prove persistence. Use a service supervisor if present; otherwise launch the foreground server executable in a separate session with all standard streams detached. Capture the launching shell's session ID, then from a fresh command check that the server is listening and its session ID differs from the launch shell's. If a detached launch fails, inspect its log and repair the launch; never fall back to a plain background job while claiming the service is durable. Finally exercise the exact client request and leave the verified listener running.

skill.name: bole-ornith-persistent-service-verifier-lifecycle-v1
skill.title: Detach verifier-facing services from the agent job manager
skill.description: Tasks requiring a daemon, server, listener or other service to remain running after the agent exits.
skill.whenToUse: Use when a task requires a daemon, server, listener, or other background process to remain running after the agent exits.
skill.body: A process started through the bash tool's run_in_background job registry is owned by the agent session and may be stopped during session cleanup. If the final artifact is a live service that a verifier will probe after the agent exits, launch it from a foreground shell call as a detached OS session, for example with `nohup setsid <command> </dev/null >/tmp/<name>.log 2>&1 &`. Record its PID, then use a separate shell call to verify both the process and the externally visible port or protocol. Use managed background jobs only for temporary work that should end with the agent session.
